citations.definition: Rates over all predicted YES. Exact requires 20..600 chars in same document. Supported additionally requires gold YES and >=80% character overlap with one expert span at any exact occurrence.

scoring.f1: 2TP/(2TP+FP+FN+unknown_negative+unobserved_negative). Unknown/unobserved positives are FN. Empty denominator scores 1.
scoring.unknowns: Missing/malformed labels remain null and unobserved. Queries treat these as unknown using strong Kleene logic.

semantics: Expert-annotation presence screening with quotes, not legal conclusions.

errors: invalid prediction JSON: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
source_sha256: missing or incorrect sha256(ctx) corpus-byte hash
queries: declared sets differ from recomputed three-valued partitions or are malformed
